exercises.instruction: Заполните пропуски, используя you should + глаголы из рамки:

answers: you should watch

parts: It’s late and you’re very tired
answers: You should go
You should eat

parts: the Science Museum. It’s very interesting.
answers: you should visit
you should wear

parts: It’s too far to walk from here to the station.
answers: You should take金币赌博

exercises.instruction: Посмотрите на картинки и напишите об этих людях. Используйте He/She shouldn’t … so … .

items.prompt: You watch TV too much.
answers: She shouldn’t watch TV so much.

items.prompt: You eat too much.
answers: He shouldn’t eat so much.

items.prompt: You work too hard.
answers: She shouldn’t work so hard.

items.prompt: You drive too fast.
answers: He shouldn’t drive so fast.

exercises.instruction: Вы не можете принять решение и советуетесь с другом. Напишите вопросы с Do you think I should … ?

items.prompt: You are in a shop. You are trying on a jacket. (buy?)
answers: Do you think I should buy this jacket?

items.prompt: You can’t drive. (learn?)
answers: Do you think I should learn (to drive)?

items.prompt: You don’t like your job. (get another job?)
answers: Do you think I should get another job?

items.prompt: You are going to have a party. (invite Gary?)
answers: Do you think I should invite Gary (to the party)?

exercises.instruction: Напишите предложения с I think … should … и I don’t think … should … .

items.prompt: We have to get up early tomorrow. (go home now)
answers: I think we should go home now.

items.prompt: That coat is too big for you. (buy it)
answers: I don’t think you should buy it.

items.prompt: You don’t need your car. (sell it)
answers: I think you should sell it.

items.prompt: Karen needs a rest. (have a holiday)
answers: I think she should have a holiday.

items.prompt: Sarah and Dan are too young. (get married)
answers: I con’t think they should get married.

items.prompt: You’re not well this morning. (go to work)
answers: I don’t think you should go to work.

items.prompt: James isn’t well today. (go to the doctor)
answers: I think he should go to the doctor.

items.prompt: The hotel is too expensive for us. (stay there)
answers: I don’t think we should stay there.

exercises.instruction: Что думаете вы? Напишите предложения с should.

items.prompt: I think
modelAnswers: I think everybody should learn another language.

items.prompt: I think everybody
modelAnswers: I think everybody should have enough food.

items.prompt: I think
modelAnswers: I think people should drive more carefully.

items.prompt: I don’t think
modelAnswers: I don’t think the police should carry guns.

items.prompt: I think I should
modelAnswers: I think I should take more exercise.

exercises.instruction:
Переведите предложения на английский язык, используя should. [попробовать = try
шоколад = chocolate
пойти погулять = go for a walk]

items.prompt: Вам стоит попробовать этот торт.
answers: You should try this cake.

items.prompt: Борису не следует так много работать.
answers: Boris shouldn’t work so much.
Boris shouldn’t work so hard.
Boris should not work so much.
Boris should not work so hard.

items.prompt: Когда, по-твоему, нам следует подарить Тому его подарок?
answers: When do you think we should give Tom his present?

items.prompt: Сейчас поздно и тебе нужно ложиться спать.
answers: It’s late and you should go to bed.
It is late and you should go to bed.

items.prompt: Вы думаете, нам нужно купить новую машину?
answers: Do you think we should buy a new car?

items.prompt: Саше не следует есть так много шоколада.
answers: Sasha shouldn’t eat so much chocolate.
Sasha shouldn’t eat so hard chocolate.
Sasha should not eat so much chocolate.
Sasha should not eat so hard chocolate.

items.prompt: Думаю, что мне стоит пойти погулять.
answers: I think I should go for a walk.

items.prompt: Я не думаю, что тебе следует плавать в реке.
answers: I don’t think you should swim in the river.
